=head1 NAME

korgwm-session - start a korgwm X11 session

=head1 SYNOPSIS

B<korgwm-session>

=head1 DESCRIPTION

B<korgwm-session> prepares the environment and then replaces itself with
B<korgwm>(1).  It is meant to be used as the C<Exec> line of a display
manager session (see F</usr/share/xsessions/korgwm.desktop>) or as the
last command of F<~/.xinitrc>.

The wrapper performs the following steps:

=over 4

=item *

exports C<XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP=korgwm> and a sane C<XDG_RUNTIME_DIR>;

=item *

sets C<_JAVA_AWT_WM_NONREPARENTING=1>, because korgwm does not reparent
windows, and C<NO_AT_BRIDGE=1>;

=item *

imports C<DISPLAY> and C<XAUTHORITY> into the systemd user session and
restarts C<xdg-desktop-portal-gtk> so that portals work;

=item *

sets the root cursor, disables the screen saver and DPMS, merges
F<~/.Xresources> if present;

=item *

applies a keyboard layout with B<setxkbmap>(1) unless F<~/.xkbmap>
exists;

=item *

executes B<korgwm>.

=back

=head1 FILES

=over 4

=item F<~/.korgwmrc>, F<~/.config/korgwm/korgwm.conf>, F</etc/korgwm/korgwm.conf>

korgwm configuration files, read in that order.

=item F<~/.xkbmap>

If this file exists, B<korgwm-session> leaves the keyboard layout alone.

=item F<~/.Xresources>

Merged into the X resource database when present.

=back

=head1 SEE ALSO

B<korgwm>(1), B<setxkbmap>(1), B<xrdb>(1), B<xsetroot>(1)
